designationHistory.indexText: The Director of the Fish and Wildlife Service established Lake Otis as a refuge under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act after the limited-interest easement lands were 'rediscovered' in 1971.

authority.citation: Director's action under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act

designationHistory.note: Unlike its neighbors, Lake Otis was not among the 1939 executive-order easement refuges and is absent from Proclamation 2416 (1940). FWS gives August 4, 1971.

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Comprehensive Conservation Plan, North Dakota Limited-interest NWRs (2006), Table 4
FWS ServCat: North Dakota Limited-Interest NWRs Compatibility Determination (2020)
